name: Spinal Epidural Hematoma
definition: Bleeding into the spinal epidural space causing acute or subacute neural compression, occurring spontaneously or after trauma, surgery, anticoagulation or procedures.

typical: Rapidly evolving weakness or sensory loss

redFlags.item: Anticoagulated patient with acute spinal pain

investigations.principle: Urgent MRI is the diagnostic test of choice; coagulation studies and cause-directed evaluation are required.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, marrow, inflammatory, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific imaging pathway.

amber: Neurological deficit may require urgent decompression; do not delay for conservative care.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Any Vata/Rakta framework is secondary to emergency modern management.

patientEducation.summary: Bleeding into the spinal epidural space causing acute or subacute neural compression, occurring spontaneously or after trauma, surgery, anticoagulation or procedures.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, sphincter change, severe infection/systemic illness, major trauma, vascular compromise or other listed red flags.
